about: One research run: an open question of the incident team put to Perplexity (its Sonar models, through OpenRouter and tools/llm.mjs), the answer split into statements in our own words, and each statement checked by opening the address the engine cited. An engine's answer is evidence about the engine, not about the storm; nothing here is a fact until it is read at the body that decides or warns. The answers' full text is not here (raw store, outside git: the raw name and sha256 point to it).
topic: Web Summit's Day 3, and what it has said since calling off Day 2

asks.question: Web Summit Lisbon 2026: after Day 2 (Wednesday 11 November) was called off for Storm Charles, has Web Summit itself confirmed that Day 3 (Thursday 12 November) goes ahead, and what has it published since about Wednesday's talks and speakers, the PITCH semi-final and final, Night Summit, and tickets or refunds? Give each Web Summit page or official post and when it was published.

settings.brief: the research brief (tools/perplexity-ask.mjs, BRIEF) with the time of asking

statements.s: It found no Web Summit page or official post confirming that Day 3 goes ahead.
statements.note: Our record (the conductor, from two newspapers) has Thursday reported confirmed in a message to participants. The engine, searching the organiser's site alone, reports nothing: all fifteen addresses are the organiser's.

statements.s: Web Summit's homepage, updated 11 November at 15:26 UTC, still gives the event as 9 to 12 November and says nothing on Thursday's arrangements.
statements.note: Not opened: websummit.com is on hold for this desk (hosts.json). Recorded as the engine's answer only.

statements.s: Web Summit's schedule still lists Wednesday's sessions, with no post on which talks are cancelled or moved.
statements.note: Not opened: websummit.com is on hold for this desk (hosts.json). Recorded as the engine's answer only.

statements.s: The PITCH semi-final's page still gives 11 November, 17:00 to 18:00, Centre Stage; the page was last updated on 10 November at 12:01 UTC.
statements.note: Not opened: websummit.com is on hold for this desk (hosts.json). Recorded as the engine's answer only. The slot is as we read it at 02:55, before the hold.

statements.s: It found no Web Summit page on the PITCH final, Night Summit, or tickets and refunds after the cancellation.
statements.note: Four hours earlier the same model gave the final's page and slot (run 3). Its answers are not stable from one asking to the next.

asks.question: Web Summit Lisboa 2026: depois de cancelado o segundo dia (quarta-feira, 11 de novembro) por causa da depressão Charles, a própria Web Summit confirmou que o terceiro dia (quinta-feira, 12 de novembro) se realiza, e o que publicou desde então sobre as palestras e oradores de quarta-feira, a semifinal e a final do PITCH, a Night Summit, e bilhetes ou reembolsos? Indique cada página ou publicação oficial da Web Summit e quando foi publicada.

settings.brief: the research brief (tools/perplexity-ask.mjs, BRIEF) with the time of asking

statements.s: Web Summit's homepage was updated on 11 November at 15:26 UTC and carries no explicit confirmation of the cancellation or of Thursday.

statements.s: Web Summit's schedule lists sessions for Wednesday and for Thursday.
statements.note: Not opened: websummit.com is on hold for this desk (hosts.json). Recorded as the engine's answer only.

statements.s: Web Summit's ticket pages and its resale policy say nothing about refunds for the cancelled day.
statements.note: Not opened: websummit.com is on hold for this desk (hosts.json). Recorded as the engine's answer only.

statements.s: It found no Web Summit publication on the cancellation, on Thursday, on Wednesday's talks, PITCH, Night Summit or refunds.
statements.note: It still does not return the organiser's own page of 10 November that called off Day 2, twenty-two hours after it was published.
